title: Law to help small businesses hurt by road construction
summary: This bill would require the Department of Small Business Services to run a program offering loans, grants, services or materials to small businesses affected by city construction projects lasting at least 30 days. Loans would be capped at $50,000 per storefront per year with interest no higher than 3 percent, and grants or reimbursements capped at $15,000 per storefront per year. The agency would have to set eligibility rules and a review timeline, generally deciding applications within 30 days and paying out awards within 14 days of approval.
